Manipur CM opposes bandh, NRC demand, citing public hardship

Manipur Chief Minister Biren Singh has opposed a bandh (shutdown) called over a demand for the National Register of Citizens (NRC). He stated that such shutdowns only cause hardship to the public. Singh urged people to shun bandhs and blockades.
